name: @blueagent/builder
description: CLI for Blue Agent — blue idea / build / audit / ship / raise / new / init / doctor / chat / validate
_comment: MEASURED 2026-09-18 — the core range below was `^0.1.2`, which no version of
core has satisfied since 1.0.0. Two consequences, both live:
ancient build whose runtime POSTs to https://llm.bankr.bot with
BANKR_API_KEY. Bankr is 403-banned for writes and the installing user has
no key either way, so the five grounded commands 401'd on arrival.
* workspace: `^0.1.2` is unsatisfiable by the local core, so a root
`npm install` fetches a registry copy into packages/builder/node_modules
and shadows the workspace symlink. The monorepo silently tests a
`*` matches the three sibling packages (skill, sdk, cli) and lets the fix in
STILL BROKEN, NOT FIXED HERE: src/bankr.ts is a SECOND, independent Bankr
client (POST llm.bankr.bot/v1/messages, model claude-sonnet-4-6) behind seven
commands — history, watch, search, launch, market, trending, chat. Those do
not go through core and are untouched by this range change. This package is
in the set ShunTr is holding; migrating it is his call, not a rider here.
